title: A Wild Sheep Chase

locations.name: The Tavern
locations.notes: The party is at their table when a sheep bursts in through the front door carrying a scroll: it is the wizard Finethir Shinebright, polymorphed. Moments later the 'shepherds' arrive. Guest rooms; a place for the chase to spill upstairs or for the party to hide the sheep.

locations.name: The Town Square
locations.notes: Guz, a half-orc mercenary, comes for the sheep with three collared wolves and a brown bear (both polymorphed henchmen). The tavern block on this map is the same building as 01a; its doors line up.

locations.name: The Main Road

areas.name: The main road and a pasture: Plank floor
The main road and a pasture: Pasture

locations.notes: A few miles out of town the side path leaves the main road at the signpost. Possible location for a road encounter or the hooks.

locations.name: The Side Path

areas.name: The side path through the woodland: Woodland floor

locations.notes: About a mile of sparse woodland between the road and the compound; the cut segment for a stealthy approach or an ambush. The stream has a stepping-stone ford.

locations.name: Noke's Tower

areas.name: Main hall / middle platform (L2, 20 ft): Deck

locations.notes: The grounds under the three oak platforms: two huts, the large outhouse (a brown bear is inside), the trunks that carry the platforms, the stair foot up to the deck. The open deck 10 ft up where the three apes idle. Stair down to the ground, stair-bridge up to the hall. The 60-ft hall 20 ft up: dining room and kitchen (north-west), sitting room (south-west), library and lab (east half). Ahmed Noke works here when not upstairs. The top platform, 30 ft up: the bedroom. Noke's last stand; the bed becomes the Bed Dragon Wyrmling; the modified wand of true polymorph is here.

pointers.title: Ewe are Very Clever... — luring Noke out
pointers.note: No new geometry: this section plays out at the compound. A scene that lures Noke down onto the ground uses `03c-compound-L0-ground` (the grounds, huts and outhouse) with the lower platform `03d` as the vantage the apes hold; a fight that stays inside uses `03e` (hall) and `03f` (bedroom). The pegged `03g` stack shows all of it at once. Files live in `../03-house-in-the-woods/`.

pointers.title: Big Choices · Consequences · Not Like This... — the epilogue
pointers.note: No new geometry: the closing scenes (using the damaged wand, its consequences, and the ending where things go wrong) return to the tavern. Use `01a-tavern-L0` and `01b-tavern-L1` from `../01-baaaa-d-news/`, or the bedroom `03f` if the ending is played at the compound.
